snapshot.scope: Validated restore blocks unsupported durable schemas, migrates compatible v1 vaults in private staging, rebuilds enabled derived indexes, and closes PIGE-BACKUP-004/E9.02.

reviewers.task: Review durable schema compatibility, staged migration and derived-index restore acceptance
reviewers.independence: Planning reviews restore and acceptance facts; Development supplies separate compatibility, migration, index and renderer evidence.

dimensions.summary: Restore keeps its existing preview/apply flow and exposes one clear body-free unsupported-schema state before any destination effect.
Archive manifests, durable-domain ranges, staged v1 migration, clone identity and restart adoption resolve to the same exact restored vault.
PIGE-BACKUP-004 and E9.02 cite current schema, migration, publication, restart, rollback, cancellation, UI and derived-index tests.
BackupRestoreService delegates compatibility, materialization and derived-index work to bounded private owners while preserving the existing coordinator.
Existing restore contracts already specify this behavior; the change adds direct evidence and bounded owners without a new design document.

The semantic-claim ledger and independent review snapshot bind the verified validated-restore workflow; normal CI remains the publication gate.

coordination.taskTitle: Bind validated restore schema, migration and derived-index acceptance
coordination.compatibility: Existing supported backups retain preview/apply behavior; only unsupported schemas fail earlier and compatible v1 backups are migrated privately before publication.
coordination.acknowledgement: Planning records complete validated restore coverage and promotes PIGE-BACKUP-004 plus E9.02 without claiming release signing or unrelated platform packaging.
